name: AC PCB Repair
tagline: Board-level repair for inverter and fixed-speed ACs
headline: Repair the board. Skip the ₹15,000 replacement.
summary: A failed control board does not have to mean a new one. Chennai's voltage swings and monsoon damp quietly kill PCBs, and brands quote ₹8,000-15,000 for a replacement. Our technicians repair inverter and fixed-speed boards at component level — from ₹1,499, with up to a 90-day warranty on the work.

symptoms.title: Dead after a power cut
symptoms.description: The AC refuses to start once mains power returns — the classic signature of surge damage on the board.

symptoms.title: Error codes on display
symptoms.description: Inverter units flash E-series codes or a blinking timer light when the board detects a drive or sensor fault.

symptoms.title: Compressor never engages
symptoms.description: The indoor fan runs but the room stays warm because the board is no longer switching the compressor on.

symptoms.title: Random shutdowns mid-cycle
symptoms.description: The unit cuts out on its own or ignores the remote — failing relays and dry capacitors behave exactly like this.

symptoms.title: MCB trips at startup
symptoms.description: A shorted component on the board can pull enough current to trip the breaker the moment the AC starts.

symptoms.title: Green corrosion on the board
symptoms.description: Sea air near the coast eats copper tracks and solder joints; visible corrosion means failure is close.

faqs.question: Is a repaired PCB as reliable as a new board?
faqs.answer: When the failed component is correctly identified and replaced with the right spec, yes. We bench-test every board before refitting and run the unit through a full cooling cycle after. The repair carries up to a 90-day warranty, so the risk sits with us, not you.

faqs.question: Why do AC control boards fail so often in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Voltage fluctuation and power-cut surges stress the board's power section until a relay, capacitor or IPM gives way. Coastal humidity and sea air add corrosion on top, especially during the monsoon. The two together make Chennai one of the hardest cities in India on AC electronics.

faqs.question: How much do I actually save by repairing instead of replacing?
faqs.answer: Brand replacement boards for split ACs typically run ₹8,000-15,000, and inverter boards sit at the top of that range. Our board-level repairs cost ₹1,499-4,999 depending on the fault. On a typical inverter board, that is a saving of ₹5,000-10,000.

faqs.question: Do you repair inverter PCBs, or only fixed-speed boards?
faqs.answer: Both. We handle inverter outdoor and indoor boards — IPM modules, IGBTs and drive circuits — across Daikin, LG, Voltas, Blue Star, Samsung, Carrier, Hitachi, O General, Mitsubishi Electric and Panasonic. Fixed-speed boards with relay, fuse or capacitor faults are usually quicker and cheaper.

faqs.question: What happens if the board cannot be repaired?
faqs.answer: We tell you plainly, with the failed section shown to you, before any money changes hands. If you want to proceed, we source a genuine brand board, fit it and test the unit. Your diagnosis charge is adjusted against the final bill either way.
